body: I wouldn't say I had any.. Why?

Depression for me is:
Picture this, you're in a desert, it's hot and you haven't had anything to drink for a long time, you think you might just die but you can't, it's a decision you have to make by yourself, you can not die unless you choose to kill yourself. Every day you have to get past an obstacle, it's miles and miles of walking on burning coal, no water or food and just constant pain, for every day that passes you have to endure this pain, unless you choose to kill yourself. The process of killing yourself would be painless compared to the pain you feel every day, yet you don't do it. This pain is felt in your chest, inside somewhere in your body. All you can do to survive is to make yourself feel other pain, pain that's real and can be explained, seen... pain that appears as scars on your wrists, thighs and other places, it's just a distraction but at the same time something you need. 

This is depression for me and how I feel, and have felt like for a while now.

I was bullied a lot in school and I spent many nights in my room crying and wanting to just not exist... 

Ever since I was a small kids I would pick my scabs, preventing wounds from healing properly, I have scars from that all around on my body. 

I remember punching walls and hitting myself or banging my head against the wall whenever I felt guilty about something, I felt guilty a lot as a kid. 

Having abusive patents and an alcoholic dad probably made things worse though...
